horns.line: The satin jazzmen have put away their horns
stanza: Well, now it's past last call for alcohol
Past recall has been here and gone
The landlord, he finally paid us all
The satin jazzmen have put away their horns
And we're standing outside of this wonderland
Looking so bereaved and so bereft
Like a Bowery bum when he finally understands
The bottle's empty and there's nothing left, mmm

horns.songTitle: The Girl in the Yellow Dress
horns.line: It's late, the hour's growing horns
stanza: It's late, the hour's growing horns
The band seems to draw her ever closer
This girl gets right down in the groove
Woos and moves
Leads him on to where they play the blues

horns.line: He turned green up to his horns
stanza: Now, the Devil, he was reading
In the Good Book one day
How that Lord created Adam
To walk the righteous way
And it made the Devil jealous
He turned green up to his horns
And he swore by things unholy
And he made one of his own

Tonight I am down to my soul

Tonight I am down to my soul
Tonight I am down to my soul
